messages:
ben: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's latency spike — root cause autoscaler thrash on dedicated pool during traffic burst. propose immediate SLO/SLA changes and owners so we don't burn error budget every weekday morning. outline below.

alice: thanks — summary looks right. i can own the rollout policy + canary config. aim to have PR with canary + autoscaler thresholds by EOD tuesday.

carla: I'll take the dashboard and alert changes. plan: add a p95 windowed panel (5m / 1h) and a separate metric for queue length. will wire alert to oncall only after we add the 30m error-budget grace window.

devon: agree on adding a graceful fallback route to a smaller model variant when latency > 500ms for > 30s. i'll own implementation and test harness. target: feature branch + perf test by next wed.

erin: can we also run a recurrence analysis? I'll run a 90-day heatmap for p95/p99 and CPU/GPU churn to see if this is weekly pattern. will post findings in the doc.

ben: incident-bot posted the postmortem doc: <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-21-latency-spike>. action items:
- SLO tweak: p95 latency target relaxed from 200ms -> 250ms only during burst window (06:30-09:30 UTC). owner: product (ben). due: 2026-03-24.
- Error budget policy: allow 30m of burst before paging. owner: alice. due: 2026-03-23.
- Dashboard + alert: add panels + route alerts -> oncall after grace window. owner: carla. due: 2026-03-22.
- Fallback routing to model-compact: owner: devon. due: 2026-03-25.
- Recurrence analysis + recommended long-term mitigations: owner: erin. due: 2026-03-26.

carla: prometheus panel query i'll add (rough):
```
avg_over_time(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le=~"0.25|0.5|1"}[5m])
```
will refine and share panel JSON. :memo:

alice: note on rollout: canary should start at 5% and ramp to 30% over 15min with a rollback if p95 > 400ms. I'll add config snippet in the PR.

devon: for fallback routing, simple rule: if tail-latency > 500ms for 30s AND error-budget remaining < 20%, route to compact. test plan in repo under `routing/e2e`.

erin: posting the recurrence heatmap results in the doc later today. early look: three spikes in last 30 days correlated with batch rebalances at 06:45 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-23 closed. postmortem uploaded and tagged with action items.

ben: recap — owners please @mention when PRs/queries/dashboards are up. I'll schedule a 15min check-in on 2026-03-23 14:00 UTC to validate. :eyes: 

carla: ack.

alice: ack.

devon: ack.

erin: ack and will ping when analysis complete.
